name: com.yonguenp.shapekit
description: Rounded rectangles, pills and circles for uGUI without sprites. Per-corner radius, outline, linear gradient, drop shadow, circular sprite crop and shape-accurate raycasts, all batched with a single material. Includes a safe area fitter and press feedback for mobile.

samples.description: Builds a demo screen at runtime: cards, pill buttons, avatars, gradients and a batching stress test.
